infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bantay uses your location to centre the map, warn you about hazards nearby and place your reports accurately. Your location is never shared with other users.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bantay needs your camera so you can photograph a hazard. The photo is what lets a barangay official verify your report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bantay needs access to your photos so you can attach an existing picture of a hazard to your report.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Bantay uses your location to centre the map and warn you about hazards nearby.

plugins.photosPermission: Bantay needs access to your photos so you can attach a picture of a hazard to your report.
plugins.cameraPermission: Bantay needs your camera so you can photograph a hazard.
